gold_sql:
SELECT s.symbol_id, COUNT(*) AS call_sites
FROM code.calls c
JOIN code.symbols s ON s.symbol_id = c.callee_symbol_id
JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = s.file_id
JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = c.caller_symbol_id
JOIN code.files cf ON cf.file_id = cs.file_id
WHERE c.call_kind = 'direct'
  AND s.kind IN ('function', 'method')
  AND NOT f.is_test AND NOT cf.is_test
GROUP BY s.symbol_id
ORDER BY call_sites DESC, s.symbol_id
LIMIT 10;
